image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a black audio cassette tape resting on a white surface. The cassette features a transparent window revealing the internal spools and magnetic tape. There is an orange handwritten label on the top face and two distinct orange stripes running horizontally across the front. The plastic casing shows signs of wear and texture.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The object exhibits the correct aspect ratio and proportions of a standard compact cassette.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flat rectangular prism with rounded corners.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The overall shape is a rectangular prism with visibly rounded corners, matching the physical form factor.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Two circular holes revealing tape spools inside.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Two distinct circular apertures are visible on the face, showing the internal mechanism.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Two spools of magnetic tape visible through circular holes.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Internal spool structures are clearly visible through the transparent windows.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rectangular opening at bottom exposing tape for player head.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The characteristic wide rectangular slot at the bottom edge is present and correctly shaped.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Surface has molded details screw holes tape guide slots and write-protect tabs.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Molded indentations corresponding to screw holes and structural ribs are visible on the casing surface.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Casing transparent or opaque plastic typically black gray or clear.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The material appears to be black plastic with transparent sections, consistent with real cassettes.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Label area on one face displaying track information artist and title.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While there is a label area with an orange sticker, the text on it is illegible gibberish ('#N06?' or similar), failing to display actual track info/artist/title as expected in a realistic generation.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Visible internal spools through transparent casing.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The transparency of the window allows visibility of the internal components.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the handwritten-style label is nonsensical scribbles rather than legible characters, a common AI artifact when rendering text.
The surface texture appears slightly noisy and uneven, lacking the smooth, uniform injection-molded finish typical of mass-produced plastic cassettes.

artifact_observations.location: Bottom left corner / Write-protect tab area
artifact_observations.reasoning: The geometry around the bottom-left corner and the write-protect tab area appears slightly melted or ill-defined, lacking sharp mechanical edges.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly identified as a cassette and not a similar rectangular object.
To rigorously analyze the illegibility of the text on the orange label and any other markings.
To check for boundary bleeding between the transparent window and the opaque casing, and verify structural integrity.
To assess the realism of the plastic textures and lighting reflections.

focus_areas: Legibility and structure of text on labels
Sharpness of molded plastic details (screw holes, tabs)
Boundary definition between transparent and opaque materials
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the orange label; AI often fails to render coherent handwriting. Also, inspect the 'melted' look of the plastic near the bottom edge where the write-protect tab should be distinct.
